--abort-on.help: Comma-separated list of HTTP status codes that cause Instaloader to abort, bypassing all retry logic.

--comments.help: Download and update comments for each post. This requires an additional request to the Instagram server for each post, which is why it is disabled by default. Requires login.

--count.help: Do not attempt to download more than COUNT posts. Applies to #hashtag, %%location_id, :feed, and :saved.

--dirname-pattern.help: Name of directory where to store posts. {profile} is replaced by the profile name, {target} is replaced by the target you specified, i.e. either :feed, #hashtag or the profile name. Defaults to '{target}'.

--fast-update.help: For each target, stop when encountering the first already-downloaded picture. This flag is recommended when you use Instaloader to update your personal Instagram archive.

--filename-pattern.help: Prefix of filenames for posts and stories, relative to the directory given with --dirname-pattern. {profile} is replaced by the profile name,{target} is replaced by the target you specified, i.e. either :feed#hashtag or the profile name. Defaults to '{date_utc}_UTC'

--geotags.help: Download geotags when available. Geotags are stored as a text file with the location's name and a Google Maps link. This requires an additional request to the Instagram server for each picture. Requires login.

--help.help: Show this help message and exit.

--highlights.help: Also download highlights of each profile that is downloaded. Requires login.

--load-cookies.help: Browser name to load cookies from Instagram

--login.help: Login name (profile name) for your Instagram account.

--max-connection-attempts.help: Maximum number of connection attempts until a request is aborted. Defaults to 3. If a connection fails, it can be manually skipped by hitting CTRL+C. Set this to 0 to retry infinitely.

--no-compress-json.help: Do not xz compress JSON files, rather create pretty formatted JSONs.

--no-iphone.help: Do not attempt to download iPhone version of images and videos.

--no-metadata-json.help: Do not create a JSON file containing the metadata of each post.

--no-pictures.help: Do not download post pictures. Cannot be used together with --fast-update. Implies --no-video-thumbnails, does not imply --no-videos.

--no-resume.help: Do not resume a previously-aborted download iteration, and do not save such information when interrupted.

--no-video-thumbnails.help: Do not download thumbnails of videos.

--password.help: Password for your Instagram account. Without this option, you'll be prompted for your password interactively if there is not yet a valid session file.

--post-filter.help: Expression that, if given, must evaluate to True for each post to be downloaded. Must be a syntactically valid python expression. Variables are evaluated to instaloader.Post attributes. Example: --post-filter=viewer_has_liked.

--post-metadata-txt.help: Template to write in txt file for each Post.

--quiet.help: Disable user interaction, i.e. do not print messages (except errors) and fail if login credentials are needed but not given. This makes Instaloader suitable as a cron job.

--request-timeout.help: Seconds to wait before timing out a connection request. Defaults to 300.

--resume-prefix.help: Prefix for filenames that are used to save the information to resume an interrupted download.

--sanitize-paths.help: Sanitize paths so that the resulting file and directory names are valid on both Windows and Unix.

--slide.help: Set what image/interval of a sidecar you want to download.

--stories.help: Also download stories of each profile that is downloaded. Requires login.

--storyitem-filter.help: Expression that, if given, must evaluate to True for each storyitem to be downloaded. Must be a syntactically valid python expression. Variables are evaluated to instaloader.StoryItem attributes.

--storyitem-metadata-txt.help: Template to write in txt file for each StoryItem.

--tagged.help: Also download posts where each profile is tagged.

--title-pattern.help: Prefix of filenames for profile pics, hashtag profile pics, and highlight covers. Defaults to '{date_utc}_UTC_{typename}' if --dirname-pattern contains '{target}' or '{dirname}', or if --dirname-pattern is not specified. Otherwise defaults to '{target}_{date_utc}_UTC_{typename}'.

_at_profile.help: Download all followees of profile. Requires login. Consider using :feed rather than @yourself.

_feed.help: Download pictures from your feed. Requires login.

_fromfile.help: Read targets (and options) from given textfile.

_saved.help: Download the posts that you marked as saved. Requires login.

_singlepost.help: Download the post with the given shortcode

_stories.help: Download the stories of your followees. Requires login.

profile.help: Download profile. If an already-downloaded profile has been renamed, Instaloader automatically finds it by its unique ID and renames the folder likewise.
